buildCommand: export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin:~/go/bin && npm install && /usr/local/go/bin/go generate ./... && npx @tailwindcss/cli -i static/css/input.css -o static/css/output.css --minify && /usr/local/go/bin/go build -o ronsdesigns ./cmd/server
installCommand: curl -fsSL https://go.dev/dl/go1.24.12.linux-amd64.tar.gz | tar -xzf - -C /usr/local && /usr/local/go/bin/go install github.com/a-h/templ/cmd/templ@latest && npm install
